newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai T-bill repo rates end up, most spots down.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai T-bill repo rates end up, most spots down.

text.p: Contracts on the treasury bill repurchase market in Shanghai closed mostly up on Tuesday thanks to the bullish domestic A share markets, traders said.
The annual rate for the most actively traded seven-day contract rose to 13.15 percent from 12.48 percent on Monday.
Total turnover of the six-contract market fell sharply to 9.0 million lots from 19.9 million.
One lot is 1,000 yuan face value of treasury bills.
Traders said the surge on the domestic A share markets was the major factor boosting fund demand.
